The '''2026 Cheltenham Borough Council election''' was held on 7 May 2026, alongside the [[2026 United Kingdom local elections|other local elections across the United Kingdom]] held on the same day, to elect 20 of 40 members of [[Cheltenham Borough Council]] in [[Gloucestershire]], [[England]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=mhclgpress |date=2026-02-16 |title=Update on May 2026 local authority elections – MHCLG in the Media |url=https://mhclgmedia.blog.gov.uk/2026/02/16/update-on-may-2026-local-authority-elections/ |access-date=2026-02-17 |website=mhclgmedia.blog.gov.uk |language=en}}</ref>

==Summary==

===Background===
In [[2024 Cheltenham Borough Council election|2024]], the [[Liberal Democrats (UK)|Liberal Democrats]] retained majority control of the council.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Norris |first=Phil |last2=Garcia |first2=Carmelo |date=2024-05-03 |title=Cheltenham Borough Council local election results and reaction - updates |url=https://www.gloucestershirelive.co.uk/news/cheltenham-news/live-cheltenham-borough-council-local-9260794 |access-date=2026-02-17 |website=Gloucestershire Live |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |title=Cheltenham result - Local Elections 2024 |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/election/2024/england/councils/E07000078 |access-date=2026-02-17 |work=BBC News |language=en-GB}}</ref> In January 2026, the council asked for the election to be postponed pending local government reorganisation.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Parker |first=Fiona |date=16 January 2026 |title=Lib Dems scrap Cheltenham elections after attacking Tories for same thing - Councillor Rowena Hay asks the Government to postpone May’s vote in Cheltenham borough council |url=https://www.telegraph.co.uk/politics/2026/01/16/lib-dems-scrap-cheltenham-elections-attacked-tories-glos/ |website=The Telegraph}}</ref> This was against the wishes of [[Leader of the Liberal Democrats]] [[Ed Davey]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Garcia |first=Carmelo |date=2025-12-20 |title=Cheltenham 2026 elections could be pushed back due to council shake-up |url=https://www.gloucestershirelive.co.uk/news/cheltenham-news/cheltenham-2026-elections-could-pushed-10712862 |access-date=2026-02-17 |website=Gloucestershire Live |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-01-07 |title=Lib Dem council to ask for election delay despite Ed Davey's warning |url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c4gw944x83lo |access-date=2026-02-17 |website=BBC News |language=en-GB}}</ref> However it was rescheduled on 16 February 2026.
